store.summary: Nomad AV Tester: HDMI patterns, EDID, lip-sync, RTA for AV techs
store.description: Part of the Nomad tools by Tech Nomad Ted, TheTechNomad.com. Turns the CardputerZero into a pocket AV test generator: color bars, crosshatch, safe-area, ramps, solids, checkerboards and a judder test box over HDMI in every mode the display offers (exact refresh rates such as 59.94 and 23.98), 1 kHz and left/right channel ID tones, and a plain-English EDID reader (maker, model, modes, audio formats, HDR) on HDMI and the built-in screen. Lip-sync tester: the screen flashes with a beep, the built-in camera (200 fps) and mic measure the A/V offset and suggest the delay fix. Audio: 1 kHz, L/R ID, pink noise, sweeps and polarity pulse out; mic level meter, SPL and 1/3-octave RTA in.
